notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard SaveInProgress and RestoreInProgress service interlocks. The test uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It checks representative declaration, object, interaction, ownership, time, data-distribution, synchronization, and advisory services during an untimed federation save and restore. It does not assert a provider-specific save format, registry, transport, header, or persistence implementation.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador declaration, publication, subscription, object, interaction, and directed-interaction services rejected while federation save or restore is active
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador declaration and object-management service declarations

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object and interaction services plus synchronization-point services rejected while federation save or restore is active
